6. **P2 — Binary truncation can produce invalid JSON text.**  
   [sanitizer.ex:214](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/support/sanitizer.ex:214) cuts binaries at an arbitrary byte boundary. With 511 ASCII bytes followed by `é`, the default 512-byte limit splits the UTF-8 character. `String.valid?/1` returned false and `Jason.encode/1` failed. This affects otherwise valid provider messages and webhook payloads. Existing truncation tests use ASCII text.  
   **Correction:** Cut valid text at a UTF-8 boundary. Define a safe representation for input binaries that are already invalid UTF-8.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
